messages:
Frank (CEO): Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands: leadership wants a single-paragraph "why we win" and a single-paragraph "why we lose" + one proposed fix per loss. Keep it tight for the board packet.

Hannah (PM): Why we win: customers pick Redwood when we can promise predictable throughput (Dedicated) + clear cost forecasts and when we demonstrate privacy controls (VPC/KMS) plus a migration plan. Why we lose: procurement often prefers self-host economics at scale, regulated customers demand on-prem/air-gapped options, and renewal risk rises when there is no simple model pinning/rollback.

Noor (Sales): Sales color: two high-ACV deals last quarter explicitly requested an on-prem appliance; another three stalled over unit-cost comparisons. Quick fix for sales: a perf/throughput one-pager with committed SLAs and sample TCO numbers.

Priya (Product): Product fixes (short): 1) add "pin to version" + revert in Console (low effort), 2) publish perf one-pager and sample TCO calculator (very low), medium: scoped on-prem runtime image with KMS hooks (higher effort).

Theo (SRE): I'll own the perf one-pager. We can include latency/throughput curves per Dedicated SKU and suggested autoscale presets. Will have a draft by Wed.

Mei (CS): From renewals: customers cite latency spikes during bursts and surprise quality drops after model updates. Those are the churn triggers that pinning/revert would directly address. I'll post three anonymized snippets.

data-bot: quick CRM tag counts since 2025-09-01: sla_commit=13, need_onprem=6, pin_model=10.

Hannah (PM): Action items: Noor -> anonymized RFP lines for the 2 on-prem deals (Tue); Theo -> perf one-pager draft (Wed); Priya -> RFC for pin/revert + acceptance criteria (Fri); Mei -> three ticket snippets (Tue); data-bot -> CSV mapping lost reason to ARR impact (Tue). Owners?

Noor (Sales): Acknowledged. Posting RFP snippets tomorrow.

Priya (Product): Acknowledged. Will scope minimal acceptance and risks.

Mei (CS): Acknowledged.

ops-bot: created doc playbooks/win-loss/q2-board-summary by @Hannah

Frank (CEO): For the board please include a single "avoidable churn" % by feature (conservative estimate). If data-bot can provide that, we can make a prioritization call.

data-bot: will produce a conservative avoidable-churn estimate with confidence intervals by Tue EOD.

Hannah (PM): Thanks team  I'll stitch the one-pager and board slide once these items land.
